component.name: Glitr
component.summary: Private messenger — your git repo is the mailbox

description.p: Glitr is a private messenger. There is no central chat server. Encrypted messages live in a git repository you own. When you are both online, Glitr can open a live link over Tor or WebRTC. When you are not, send falls back to the mailbox.
Works offline. Pair for a live session. Voice and video on an open live link. This project is unaudited — read the documentation at glitr.io before relying on it.
